text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet affairs and information minister arrives in Cairo at head of team attending a meeting of Arab ministers.
- Oil minister decrees setting up a panel to identify snags in industrial development.
- Bahrain's cabinet supports European calls for the establishment of a Palestinian state.
- Bahrain's emir receives a Jordanian military delegation and discuss boosting security cooperation.
- Labour minister confirms the need to develop social centres operating in Bahrain.
- Chamber of commerce plans a seminar on tourism and investments in Bahrain.
- Official sources say commerce ministry to discuss changes in law governing trading agencies.
